༄༅/khams gsum 'gro ba'i bla ma 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs kyi gsung rab dpe bsdur ma pod bzhi pa bzhugs/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ khams gsum 'gro ba'i bla ma 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs kyi gsung rab dpe bsdur ma pod bzhi pa bzhugs/ /

༄༅/ /bstod dbyangs rgya mtsho snyan dngags rin po che'i rgyan rnam par bkra ba bzhugs so/ / ༄༅/ /na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ bstod dbyangs rgya mtsho snyan dngags rin po che'i rgyan rnam par bkra ba zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi rang bzhin nam mkha'i dbyings ltar gdod nas rnam dag srid dang zhi ba'i dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin nyid gyur nyer zhi yang*/ /gzhan don dga' ba'i thugs rje'i rgyal mtshan rnam par bsgreng zhing sna tshogs thabs brtsom shes bya kun sbyangs smon lam rgya mtsho las 'khrungs pas | | thun mong ba dang phul du byung ba'i yon tan dpal gyis rnam par brgyan pa'i sku gsung thugs ldan gsang ba mtha' yas mi zad pa/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin las bzang pos sna tshogs gdul ba'i 'dod rgu'i dpal 'byor yongs su rdzogs mdzad bla ma mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsod nams rgya mtshos rnam bskrun zhing*/ /ye shes tshogs kyis che ba'i sku/ /brnyes pa khyod kyis srid pa yi// nyes pa rtsad nas gzhom pa'i slad/ /'jig rten spyod las rnam grol bas/ /yon tan rgya mtsho'i yon tan gyi/ /cha yang nyams pa mi mnga' na/ /'chi 'pho lta yang ga la mchis/ /de lta mod kyi gdul bya yi/ /ri la 'char dang nub par snang*// 'on kyang mdzad pa'i phrin las la/ /'phel 'grib yang ye ma mchis shing*// dngos grub dag kyang mos pa yi/ /yid kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i slad/ /bcom ldan bzhugs dang gshegs pa dang*/ khyod kyi sku dang sku gzugs 'di/ /tha dad lta bur snang na yang*/ /rang gi rang bzhin dag pa dang*/ /mdzad pa dag gis rnam kun tu/ /gnyis su med par bdag gis 'tshal/ /srid la sred pa'i srad bu'i 'ching bral slad/ /thogs med slad du 'dir yang thogs med lags/ /'gro ba kun la thugs rje goms pa'i phyir/ /'dir yang thugs rje rjes 'dzin gdon mi za | | de slad bsod nams bye ba phrag brgya yis/

/nye bar bsgrubs pa'i sku ltar sku gzugs 'di/ /kun nas mos slad mkhyen brtse nus pa yis/ /rnam par gzigs shing nye bar dgongs nas kyang*/ /mos pa ji bzhin byin gyis rlob mdzad la/ /re ba'i 'bras bu yongs su rdzogs bgyi'i slad/ /thun mong ba dang phul du byung ba yi/ /dngos grub rin chen char yang dbab tu gsol/ /de ltar dngos grub don du dngos grub 'byung gnas skyob pa khyod la bdag /dngos po kun gyis kun tu 'dud cing mchod pa'i sprin gyi rgya mtsho yis/ /nye bar mchod phyir mchod 'os khyod kyi tshul yang tshul bzhin nges bgyi'i slad/ /legs par gsungs pa'i gsung gi mdzod las ji ltar rtogs bzhin gleng bar 'tshal/ / yon tan pha rol phyin pa bzhi/ /brnyes pa khyod kyis dam pa'i don/ /'gro 'ong med par thugs chud slad/ /mi g.yo bar yang bzhugs pa lags/ /de lta mod kyi cho 'phrul gsum gyis rnam par 'phrul khyod bye ba phrag brgya'i zhing*/ /gzhan du gzhan la mos pa ji bzhin kun tu sprul pa'i sku yi rnam 'phrul gang*/ /skad cig gcig la'ang bgrang ba las 'das nye bar ston mdzad yid ltar mgyogs pa ste/ /mdzad pa de dag rmad du byung ba'i 'bras bu mchog gis brgyan par smos ci 'tshal/ /bsam gyis mi khyab dam pa'i don/ /gzigs pa khyod kyis chos kyi dbyings | | brjod du med par thugs chud slad/ /mi gsung bar yang bzhugs pa lags/ /de lta mod kyi mi 'jigs bzhi yis bsnyengs pa dang bral zhing/ / so so yang dag rig pa bzhi la kun nas dbang 'byor khyod/ /bye ba phrag brgya'i chos kyi sgo yis sna tshogs rab bkra'i dngos/ /nye bar mtshon phyir gzhan du chos kyi char chen 'bebs mdzad lags/ /dag pa gnyis kyis rnam dag pas/ / dbyings dang kun tu ro gcig phyir/ /spros pa'i mtshan ma rab zhi'i slad/ /mi rtog par yang bzhugs pa lags/ /de lta mod kyi mgon po khyod kyis bskal pa rgya mtshor shes bya kun la kun nas legs sbyangs shing*/

/sdug bsngal rgya mtshor rnam par bying ba'i sems can rgya mtsho grangs mtha' yas la rab tu brtse ba yi/ / thugs rje chen pos rnam par brlan pa'i yang dag thabs la rab tu brtson mdzad smon lam rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /legs par grub pas shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ji snyed mkhyen phyir mkhyen pa'ang shes bya ji bzhin bkra ba lags/ /de ltar gang la phyag bya ba'i/ /yul de phyag 'aus thams cad kyi/ /rang bzhin lags par legs 'tshal nas/ /slar yang de la phyag bgyi'o/ kha dog med cing dbyibs dang bral// gong bu med cing rdul yang med/ /bstan du med cing bltar med pa/ /gzugs bral khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan dang ldan/ /dpe byad brgyad cus rnam par spras/ /'od zer phreng (《 zha ¡· 'bar ) bas lam me ba/ / bltar 'os khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yi ge med cing ming dang bral/ /tshig gi tshogs ni rnam par spangs/ /sgra med mnyan du med pa can/ /brjod bral khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gag pa med cing sgo kun nas/ /yan lag drug cus brgyan pa yi/ /dbyangs kyis chos rnams legs sgrogs pa/ /mnyan 'os khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam shes med cing yid dang bral/ /rnam par rtog pa kun spangs shing | | mtshan ma thams cad rab zhi ba/ /dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo | | ji lta ba dang ji snyed mkhyen/ /ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs kyi gter/ /'gro ba'i yid la mnyam 'jug pa/ /bsam bya khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi rang bzhin gdod ma nas/ /'dus ma byas pa'i mtshan nyid phyir/ /gzhi med slad du khyad par dang*/ /bral ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor ba'i chos rnams bgrangs yas pa/ /lam gyi bden pas rab bsgyur phyir/ /yon tan rgya mtshos khyad par du/ /'phags pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / gzung ba dang ni 'dzin pa'i chos | | gang lags gang gis rnam kun tu/ /spang ba'i slad du bya byed las/ / grol ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshogs dang yongs su bsgyur ba dang*/

/thabs dang rnam par gtong ba yis/ /yul dus rnam par mdzad pa yang*/ /rgya chen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mnyam dang mi mnyam srid zhi yi/ /'du byaid gang lags bcom pa'i slad/ /mtha' rnams kun la mi gnas pa/ /rnam grol khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dzin dang grol ba'i ye shes kyis/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa la | | mnyam pa nyid du legs gnas pa/ /srid zhi'i dbang phyug phyag 'tshal lo// kun 'byung spros pa'i mtshan ma yis/ /rnam pa kun tu ma spros shing*/ /spros pa nye bar gcod mdzad pa/ /spros bral khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thabs mkhas thugs rje'i spros pa yis/ /rnam pa kun tu rab spros shing*/ /mdzad pa'i phrin las spros mdzad pa/ /spros bcas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpe rnams bye ba phrag brgya yis/ /dpe tsam nyid du'ang mi bzod cing*/ /dpe zla kun dang rnam bral ba/ /dpe med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpe dang gtan tshigs thams cad dang | | yi ge ming dang tshig gi tshogs/ /brda rnams kun gyis rnam kun tu/ / mtshon bya khyod la phyag 'tshalalo/ /de slad bla ma'i bla ma ste/ /chen po'i chen por gyur pa lags/ /mchod 'os rnams kyis mchod 'os pa/ /phyag 'os khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar phyag 'os thub pa khyod la phyag bgyis nas/ /slar yang bsod nams zhing gi mchog la bsod nams kyi/ /lo tog dam pa kun nas spel slad kun bzang gi /rnam 'phrul ji bzhin mchod pa'i sprin gyis mchod par bgyi | | sgyu ma mkhan gyis sgyu ma'i rdzas ltar mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i rnam 'phrul spro phyir mchod pa'i rdzas/ /snam sbyar chos gos snam phran glegs bu kun nas sbyar legs padma dmar po ltar dmar ba/ /gser gyi ri mo gser gyi 'od 'byin bkram pas cher bkra lcags ri'i khor yug mu tig gi /phreng ba zung gis phreng du dngar zhing zung du sbyar 'di ting 'dzin sgyu 'phrul gyis sprul pas/ /mchod pa'i rnam 'phrul zhing khams rgya mtsho rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin

phung gis/ /rnam par brgyan pa'i rgyan gyi 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro ba'i 'od kyi rtse mor rgya mtsho yi/ /rdul gyi grangs snyed rin chen padmo rin chen 'od 'byin kun nas rgyas pa'i snying po la/ /lha dang mi yi 'dod yon rmad ni 'dod rgu'i dpal 'byung bye ba phrag brgya legs gnas pa/ /kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul ji bzhin kun nas dge ba'i sems kyis sprul pa'i mchod sprin 'di/ /chos dbyings ji bzhin nam mkha'i dbyings kun kun nas khyab cing sems can dbyings mtha' ji srid par/ /rnam par gnas nas chos kyi rgyal po rgyal ba rgyal sras rang rgyal dgra las rnam rgyal bas/ /kun nas bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor kun tu rnam par mchod pas mchod pa kun gyis mnyes gyur cig /mchod rdzas dri med lha yi gos/ /yid 'ong mdzes pa gang gi sku/ /mtshan gyi dpal gyis 'bar ba gang*/ /kun nas g.yogs pas mdzes byas pa/ /rin chen gser gyi lhun po'i rgyal/ /tsha zer byed pas bzhu ba'i sprin/ /padma rā ga'i mdog (《 zha 》 'od ) snang bas/ /yongs su bskor ba lta bu lags/ /yang na bcom ldan khyod sku dri med nyin mor byed pa'i dkyil 'khor lta bur kun nas rab tu gsal ba gang*// chos gos 'od zer snam phran glegs bu'i phreng ba spel legs nye bar 'khrigs pa blta na sdug pas yongs bskor bas/ /mdzes pa gzhan kun skar ma'i tshogs ltar zil gyis mnan nas ∶ gdul bya (《 zha 》《 lu 》 - gdul bya ) rab dga'i me tog padmo'i tshal rab rgyas byed cing*/ /snyan dngags mkhan gyi sbrang rtsi 'dzin pas snyan dngags ngag gi bstod dbyangs dar dir kun tu sgrogs par bgyid pa lags/ / yang na khyod sku lhun po bzhin/ /chos gos nam mkha' lta bur mchis/ /de la gser gyi ri mo ni/ /bkram pa gza' skar tshogs ltar bkra/ /yang na rgyal ba'i gzhal med khang mdzes shin tu dwangs pa'i yid bzhin mtshor/ /na bza' chos gos chu skyes dmar po'i 'dab rgyas lta bur snang ba'i dkyil/

/bcom ldan khyod sku yongs su rdzogs pa'i snying po ltar yang mdzes pa ste/ /mtshan gyi dpal dang dpe byad bzang po'i ze'u 'bru'i phreng bas spras pa lags/ /de slad de yi snyan pa'i dri bsung phyogs bcur khyab pas nyer bsdus pa'i/ /dad ldan bung ba'i sprin phung lta bur nye bar 'khrigs pas khyod kyi sku/ /dpal gyis 'bar ba mngon sum snang bas yid rab 'phrogs pas bsngags pa yi/ /dar dir sgra dbyangs sgrogs par bgyid rnams dngos grub sbrang rtsis tshim mdzad lags/ /yang na thub pa khyod kyis khams/ /chos rnams kun gyi dbyings nyid lags/ /de la kun rdzob cher bkra'i chos/ /nye bar bstan pa nyer mtshon slad/ khyod sku lhun po ltar bstan pa'i/ /rten la zhing khams rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /rnam par bkra ba'i chos gos ni/ /brten pa ltar yang gyur pa lags/ /yang na gang tshe thub pa'i rnam 'phrul mig 'phrul mkhan gyi sgyu 'phrul lta bur sprul mdzad pa/ /de tshe zhing khams rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed 'grib pa med par khyod kyi sku yi dkyil 'khor la/ / kun tu snang ba'i snang ba dam pa skye rgu kun la kun nas skyed mdzad ji bzhin du | | 'di yi sku gzugs brtan par bzhugs la chos gos zhing khams rgya mtsho bkram pa'ang snang ba lags/ /de 'dra snang bas gang gi yid/ /kun nas 'phrog par bgyid pa ni/ /'dod ldan dag gi lha mo'i lus/ /yid 'ong mthong ba lta bur mchis/ /kun nas nyon mongs dri bral slad/ /shin tu mtshungs pa'ang ma lags so/ /nga dang nga yir 'dzin pa yis/ /kun tu rtog pa kun bral yang*/ / 'gro ba'i yid ni yongs bsgyur bas/ /sgyu ma'i sprul pa lta bur mchis/ /dge ba'i sa bon brtas bgyid slad/ /shin tu mtshungs pa'ang ma lags so/ /de yis dad pa'i chu gter ni/ /rnam par rgyas par bgyid pas na/ /char chen rab tu 'bebs bgyid pa'i/ /rnam par sgrogs pa'i sprin 'drar mchis/ /'bras bu 'byin pas mi zad slad/

/shin tu mtshungs pa'ang ma lags so/ /'gro ba rnams kyi bsod nams kyi/ /lo tog yongs su 'phel ba yi/ /rten gyi dam par gyur pas na/ /sa chen dang yang 'dra bar mchis/ /kun gyi bla na lham pa'i slad/ / shin tu mtshungs pa'ang ma lags so/ /dad can rnams kyis smon bgyid pa'i/ / 'dod rgu'i dpal 'byor gang lags pa/ /de kun yongs su rdzogs bgyid pas// lha yi dpag bsam shing 'drar mchis/ /yang srid rnam par sun 'byin slad/ / shin tu mtshungs pa'ang ma lags so/ /gsol ba btab na sgra med kyang*/ /dad ldan rnams kyi yid la chos/ /shin tu nges par bgyid pa ni/ /rang rgyal rnams kyi 'phrul 'drar mchis/ /phrin las rtsol ba mi mnga'i slad/ /shin tu mtshungs pa'ang ma lags so/ /skye rgu'i blo gros padmo'i ni/ /kun nas kha 'byed bgyid pas na/ /chu skyes rnam par rgyas byed pa'i/ /tsha zer byed pa lta bur mchis/ / gdung ba dag kyang sel bgyid slad/ /shin tu mtshungs pa'ang ma lags so/ / 'gro ba'i log par sred pa yi/ /yid kyi dri ma 'phrog bgyid pas/ /mig gi rab rib rnam sel ba'i/ /bsil zer byed pa lta bur mchis/ /kun tu 'grib pa ma mchis slad/ /shin tu mtshungs pa'ang ma lags so/ /srid zhi'i rgud pa rnam sel zhing | | lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi/ /rgyan gyi dam par gyur pas na/ / dbang gi rgyal po lta bur mchis/ /ye shes chen po'i dbang bgyid slad/ /shin tu mtshungs pa'ang ma lags so/ /de ltar rmad du byung ba'i chos/ /shin tu ngo mtshar gyur pa rnams/ khyod kyi cha yi dpe zlar mchis/ /kun nas mtshungs pa 'ga' ma mchis | | de slad dpe rnams thams cad kyis/ /mtshon yang bas pa ma mchis so// chos rgyal 'phags pa'i gsung rab dpe bsdur ma pod bzhi pa/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ sa skya bka' 'bum/ PAGE 8PAGE 7
